_comment: Valentine's Day collection. Each name in 'lines' brings in its WHOLE evolutionary line. The 18 lines were picked with `generate.py pick --count 18 --seed valentine-hearts` (lines may be shared with other collections since #24), Luvdisc swapped in from St. Patrick's Day for Marshadow, then given a look each (three lines per look). Shared look in styles/_valentine.py.

readme.title: Valentine's Day
looks: each line wears one look: pink covered in hearts (Luvdisc, Clefairy, Buneary); a love letter with a wax heart seal (Mr. Mime, Yamask, Hoopa); chocolate with drizzle and a frosted heart (Bunnelby, Roggenrola, Makuhita); cupid white with golden arrows (Snom, Flittle, Gligar); swirling red roses (Goldeen, Heatmor, Regieleki); pastel candy hearts (Goomy, Mankey, Anorith)
the hearts glow softly and beat in the dark; the eyes keep their own colours
shiny: the love turned round the colour wheel
